scope: all validation pitches; test split remains reserved

metric_notes.native_time_nrmse: sample-aligned error including native gain and DC
metric_notes.level_matched_time_nrmse: sample-aligned centered unit-RMS shape error, corresponding most closely to listening preparation
metric_notes.phase_aligned_time_nrmse: centered unit-RMS shape error after ignoring one whole-wave phase/time shift
metric_notes.complex_harmonic_nrmse: centered unit-RMS complex harmonic error; includes relative and absolute phase at the fixed trigger alignment
metric_notes.magnitude_harmonic_nrmse: centered unit-RMS harmonic-magnitude error; ignores harmonic phase
metric_notes.spectral_residual_dbc: energy outside guarded intended harmonic bins; more negative is better and this is not a target-distance metric

listening_comparison.note: descriptive comparison with one listener's six diagnostic rankings; not a fitted objective or population statistic
